links.outcome: Accuracy and adequacy of LLM answers against guideline-derived sarcoma questions, scored by experts
links.effect: ChatGPT-4 outperformed ChatGPT-3.5 in accuracy (median 5.5 vs 5.0) and adequacy (5.0 vs 4.0); both occasionally gave misleading, potentially life-threatening information.
links.quote: Despite their potential as a supportive tool, both models occasionally offered misleading and potentially life-threatening information.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the baseline accuracy and adequacy of ChatGPT-3.5 vs ChatGPT-4 on guideline-derived clinical sarcoma questions; it does not test a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
